### Regime detection -- `gaussian` (IMM-PF, 10000 steps, 34.6% truly stressed)

| threshold | onset: spells | detected | detected (len>=5) | median delay | mean delay | p90 delay | pre-declared | recovery: detected | median delay | steady-calm false alarms | steady-stress recall |

| 0.5 | 256 | 1.00 | 1.00 (n=166) | 0 | 0.0902 | 0 | 0.02 | 0.98 | 0 | 0.002 | 0.994 |

Delays are in steps and exist only for detected spells (optimistic alone; read with the detection rate). `pre-declared` = fraction of spells where P(target) was already >= threshold the step BEFORE the switch.

Controlled test (calm, then forced stress on steps 20-39, then calm; 40 seeds): onset detected in 100% (median delay 0 steps), recovery declared in 100% (median delay 0 steps), false alarm before the window in 0% of episodes.
